draft_en.subject: LightOptics packing - the 4+2 and 8+2 industrial PoE footprints, managed on Marvell
draft_en.body:
Hello LightOptics team,

Your LO-IGS-4GT2GF-POE and LO-IGS-8GT2GF-POE sit exactly on the 4+2 and 8+2 industrial PoE footprints we build. In LightOptics packing from small lots, DIN-rail, -40 to 75 C, CE/RoHS: 4 x Gigabit PoE+ + 2 x SFP unmanaged - model STI-244GP - $35 USD EXW (MOQ 1, 15-day validity); 8 x PoE+ + 2 x SFP unmanaged - STI-288GP - $62.2; and the differentiator against your current source, the 8 + 2 L2+ managed version with ring redundancy on a Marvell platform - STI-288DGGPM - $137.5. Optics and DAC stay with you.

One question: is the managed 8-port the SKU your ISP customers ask for, or do they stay unmanaged?

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
